title: Mystery at the Guinness Storehouse
subtitle: 5 suspects, 5 items, 5 locations
storyTitle: The Mystery of the Missing AI Assistant
storyHtml:
Byte was enjoying the Dynavics AI Event at the Guinness Storehouse when the demonstration’s AI assistant suddenly disappeared from every screen.

Each member of the Marketing team brought one suspicious item to one location, but only one person sabotaged the demonstration.

Between presentations, networking and perfectly poured pints, Byte gathered the evidence and began marking the Deduction Grid.

clues.text: The suspect in the Gravity Bar was Vickie.
The Speaker Pass was brought by a member of the AI Event Committee, and only Jacob was allowed to join the AI Event Committee.
An AI Clicker was reflected in Lou’s glasses.
Traces of a Pint of Guinness were found in the Presentation Hall.
Whoever was on the Storehouse Floor had either the Pint of Guinness or the Event Microphone.
Aleia was definitely not alongside the person who brought the Event Microphone.
Either Lou brought the AI Clicker or Lou was in the Archive Room, but not both.
The Pint of Guinness was involved in the disappearance of the AI assistant.
